findings.evidence: Analysis of the specified files indicates that sessionStorage and state flags are used locally for app and helper navigation state. No user files, documents, or file names are accessed or transferred off-device.
findings.recommendation: No action required. Local usage of session storage for UI and navigation state is compliant and exempt from off-device data safety disclosures.

findings.evidence: MediaController, MediaSession, and AppFunction integrations in MainActivity, MyApplication, and MaveAppFunctionService manage local audio playback and AI audio stream presentation. User music files from device storage are neither collected nor transferred off-device.
findings.recommendation: No action required. On-device media playback control and local audio session management are exempt from data collection disclosures.
